_comment: Housing plots (docs/HOUSING.md). plot id: {name, chunk, loc [x, y, z], yaw, cost (copper), upkeep, buildings: [{type, name, prefab (compoundobjectMD.tab root prefab), fixtures, chests}]}. A plot for sale shows a For Sale sign; a built plot shows the house. Placeholder data (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md). materials: {item name: count} makes a building a construction project: it is built once the owner has added the materials (Building Construction window). npcs: [mobs.json keys] are the NPCs the building may hold (Manage NPCs window).
